title: The 10 Best Electric Pressure Cookers
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for electric pressure cookers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at electric pressure cookers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Instant Pot Duo 7-in-1 6-Quart
strengths: Most recipes, guides, and community support of any electric pressure cooker
7 functions eliminate separate slow cooker and rice cooker
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Breville Fast Slow Pro 6-Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: 11 PSI and 15 PSI, Electric, Breville.
strengths: The only widely available electric pressure cooker with a true 15 PSI mode
Breville 2-year warranty and premium build quality
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Ninja Foodi 8-Quart Pressure Cooker and Air Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: Pressure + air fry, TenderCrisp, 8-quart.
strengths: Pressure cooks then crisps in the same pot
TenderCrisp approach gives crispy finishes on pressure-cooked meals
limitations: Two lids to manage and store
More complex than a basic pressure cooker

products.name: Instant Pot Duo Plus 9-in-1 6-Quart
strengths: Adds programs beyond the standard Duo

products.name: Instant Pot Ultra 10-in-1 6-Quart

products.name: Instant Pot Duo Crisp + Air Fryer 8-Quart
